items.briefing:
Scammers are increasingly using AI tools to run more convincing and large-scale fraud operations, and this trend is hitting Australian organisations hard. Industry voices at this week's SAS Innovate event highlighted that traditional anti-scam approaches are struggling to keep up, with AI enabling criminal groups to personalise attacks at speed and scale previously impossible. Staff should be especially cautious of unexpected emails, calls, or messages that feel unusually polished or urgent.

As a practical tip: if you receive a request for payment, login details, or personal information — even if it looks legitimate — always verify through a separate, known contact method before acting.

featured.title: SAS Innovate: New era of scams requires novel solutions
featured.quote: Australians losing billions to AI-driven fraud demands urgent industry collaboration and novel solutions.
